# Claude Code Token Attribution Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Wire token usage and active duration from Claude Code sessions into ClickUp tasks, attributed automatically via a project reference code (`CC-<YY><seq4>`) generated by the calculator and round-tripped through a `.cc-project` sidecar + git-remote RPC.

**Architecture:** The calculator is the source of truth for the project↔ClickUp binding. When `push-to-clickup` provisions a project it stamps it with a `project_code`, sets a custom field on the ClickUp parent task, and stores `git_remote_url`. Two `~/.claude/hooks/` scripts close the loop: a `SessionStart` hook resolves the active project from a `.cc-project` file (committed to the repo) or falls back to a Supabase RPC keyed on git remote; a `Stop` hook parses the session JSONL, sums tokens by model, computes ZAR cost, and PATCHes four ClickUp custom fields on the parent task. AI cost stays *hidden in the retainer* per Decision D7 — invoicing is unchanged.

**Tech Stack:** Supabase Postgres (migrations + RPC), Deno Edge Functions, ClickUp REST API v2, Python 3 (Stop hook), bash (SessionStart hook), React/TypeScript (UI).

**Wiki references:**
- `[[research/ai-usage-tracking/_index]]` — master synthesis (12 active decisions)
- `[[AI Usage Tracking Architecture v0.1]]` — D1, D4, D6, D7, D11 are load-bearing
- `[[research/ai-usage-tracking/05-implementation-architecture]]` — extension points

**Decisions locked for this build:**
- D13: `.cc-project` carries full metadata (project_code, project_name, clickup_task_id, list_id) — survives offline.
- D14: Manual download from project page for V1 — `claude init` step deferred.
- D15: One ClickUp parent task per project in the existing client list — no folder/list explosion.
- Binding: `.cc-project` (committed) + git-remote RPC fallback. Existing `/task <id>` slash command remains for sub-task overrides only.

## Phase 1 — Schema: `project_code` + `git_remote_url` + generator

### Task 1.1: Write migration `0024_project_code.sql`

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/migrations/0024_project_code.sql`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the migration**

```sql
-- 0024_project_code.sql
-- Apply via mcp__cc-supabase__apply_migration (name: project_code)
--
-- Adds the canonical cross-system reference code for projects: CC-<YY><seq4>
-- Generated server-side at insert time via a year-partitioned sequence.
-- Stored unique + immutable on projects. Mirrored to ClickUp as a custom
-- field on the parent task and embedded in the .cc-project sidecar so
-- Claude Code SessionStart hooks can attribute token usage back to the
-- right ClickUp parent task.
--
-- Also adds git_remote_url so the SessionStart hook can resolve a project
-- from `git remote get-url origin` when no .cc-project file is present.

create sequence if not exists public.project_code_seq;

-- Resets to 1 every January 1st via the generator function below — the
-- sequence itself is monotonic forever; the function modulos by year and
-- restarts client-side numbering. Keeping the sequence monotonic means
-- we never lose uniqueness even if the year-modulo breaks.

create or replace function public.generate_project_code()
returns text
language plpgsql
as $$
declare
  v_year text;
  v_seq int;
begin
  v_year := to_char(now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg', 'YY');
  -- Per-year counter: count existing CC-<YY>* codes and add 1.
  -- Cheap because projects table is bounded (~200 rows/yr) and we only
  -- run this on insert.
  select coalesce(max(
    case
      when project_code like ('CC-' || v_year || '%')
        then substring(project_code from 6)::int
      else 0
    end
  ), 0) + 1
  into v_seq
  from public.projects;

  return 'CC-' || v_year || lpad(v_seq::text, 4, '0');
end;
$$;

alter table public.projects
  add column if not exists project_code text,
  add column if not exists git_remote_url text;

-- Backfill existing rows: assign codes in created_at order so older
-- projects get lower numbers within their year.
do $$
declare
  r record;
  v_year text;
  v_count int := 0;
begin
  for r in
    select id, created_at
      from public.projects
     where project_code is null
     order by created_at asc
  loop
    v_year := to_char(r.created_at at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg', 'YY');
    v_count := v_count + 1;
    update public.projects
       set project_code = 'CC-' || v_year || lpad(v_count::text, 4, '0')
     where id = r.id;
  end loop;
end $$;

alter table public.projects
  alter column project_code set not null;

create unique index if not exists projects_project_code_idx
  on public.projects (project_code);

-- Default trigger: stamp project_code on insert if NULL. This lets the
-- Edge Function omit the column and rely on the DB to assign it, OR
-- pre-compute it client-side (e.g. for echoing into the UI before insert).
create or replace function public.tg_projects_assign_code()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
as $$
begin
  if new.project_code is null then
    new.project_code := public.generate_project_code();
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists projects_assign_code on public.projects;
create trigger projects_assign_code
  before insert on public.projects
  for each row execute function public.tg_projects_assign_code();

-- Index on git_remote_url to support the resolve_project_for_repo RPC.
-- Partial index excludes nulls — older projects without a captured remote
-- don't bloat the index.
create index if not exists projects_git_remote_url_idx
  on public.projects (git_remote_url)
  where git_remote_url is not null;
```

## Phase 2 — Augment `push-to-clickup` to set ClickUp custom fields

The existing function already provisions the ClickUp parent task. We add: capture `git_remote_url` from the request body, write it to the new column, and set 5 custom fields on the parent task (`project_code`, `ai_input_tokens`=0, `ai_output_tokens`=0, `ai_cost_zar`=0, `ai_duration_minutes`=0). Initialising the AI fields to 0 means the Stop hook can rely on `POST /task/.../field/...` returning 200 even on first write (ClickUp accepts both create and update via the same endpoint).

### Task 2.1: Add new field resolver helper

**Files:**
- Modify: `supabase/functions/_shared/clickup.ts`

- [ ] **Step 1: Add `resolveCustomField` helper to clickup.ts**

Append this to the bottom of `supabase/functions/_shared/clickup.ts`:

```typescript
/**
 * Find a ClickUp custom field definition by name (case-insensitive).
 * Returns the field id + type, or null. Caller decides how to format the
 * value for `POST /task/{id}/field/{field_id}` based on the type.
 *
 * Handles the same `cuFields` shape that push-to-clickup loads via
 * `GET /list/{id}/field`.
 */
export function findCustomField(
  cuFields: Array<{ id: string; name: string; type: string }>,
  name: string,
  expectedType?: string,
): { id: string; type: string } | null {
  const needle = name.trim().toLowerCase();
  const field = cuFields.find((f) => f.name.trim().toLowerCase() === needle);
  if (!field) return null;
  if (expectedType && field.type !== expectedType) return null;
  return { id: field.id, type: field.type };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Set parent task custom fields after parent created**

Find `const parent = await parentRes.json();` (around line 134). Add directly below:

```typescript
    // Set custom fields on the parent task: project_code (text) +
    // four AI tracking fields initialised to 0. The Stop hook updates
    // the AI fields on every Claude Code session end. If any of these
    // fields are missing in ClickUp, we log + continue (don't fail the
    // whole push — the field setup is a one-time UI task that may lag
    // behind a code deploy).
    const parentFields: Array<{ id: string; value: string | number }> = [];
    const codeField = findCustomField(cuFields, "Project Code", "short_text");
    if (codeField) {
      parentFields.push({ id: codeField.id, value: projectCode });
    } else {
      console.warn(`Custom field "Project Code" not found on list ${projectsList.id} — skipping`);
    }

    for (const fname of [
      "AI Input Tokens",
      "AI Output Tokens",
      "AI Cost ZAR",
      "AI Duration Minutes",
    ]) {
      const f = findCustomField(cuFields, fname);
      if (f) parentFields.push({ id: f.id, value: 0 });
    }

    // Set fields one-at-a-time via the per-field POST endpoint. PUT /task
    // silently drops custom fields — see CLAUDE.md and Quartz wiki entry.
    for (const f of parentFields) {
      const cfRes = await fetch(
        `https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/task/${parent.id}/field/${f.id}`,
        {
          ...CU,
          method: "POST",
          body: JSON.stringify({ value: f.value }),
        },
      );
      if (!cfRes.ok) {
        console.warn(`CU custom field ${f.id} on parent ${parent.id}: ${await cfRes.text()}`);
      }
    }
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Add an `updateGitRemote` mutation in `useProjects.ts`**

Find the existing `useUpdateProject` hook. Add a new sibling:

```typescript
export function useUpdateGitRemote() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (args: { id: string; git_remote_url: string | null }) => {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("projects")
        .update({ git_remote_url: args.git_remote_url })
        .eq("id", args.id);
      if (error) throw error;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["project"] });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["projects"] });
    },
  });
}
```

## Phase 5 — Postgres RPC: `resolve_project_for_repo`

### Task 5.1: Write migration `0025_resolve_project_for_repo.sql`

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/migrations/0025_resolve_project_for_repo.sql`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the migration**

```sql
-- 0025_resolve_project_for_repo.sql
-- Apply via mcp__cc-supabase__apply_migration (name: resolve_project_for_repo)
--
-- Called by ~/.claude/hooks/sessionstart-cc-project.sh when no .cc-project
-- file is found at the project root. Looks up the project from a git
-- remote URL.
--
-- Normalisation: strips a trailing ".git", trailing slash, and lowercases
-- the host. github.com URLs in HTTPS and SSH form normalise to the same
-- canonical key (host/owner/repo).

create or replace function public.normalise_git_remote(remote text)
returns text
language plpgsql
immutable
as $$
declare
  v text;
begin
  if remote is null or remote = '' then return null; end if;
  v := trim(remote);
  -- SSH form: git@github.com:org/repo.git → github.com/org/repo
  if v ~ '^git@' then
    v := regexp_replace(v, '^git@([^:]+):', 'https://\1/');
  end if;
  v := regexp_replace(v, '^https?://', '');
  v := regexp_replace(v, '\.git$', '');
  v := regexp_replace(v, '/$', '');
  return lower(v);
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.resolve_project_for_repo(remote text)
returns table (
  project_code text,
  project_name text,
  clickup_parent_task_id text,
  calculator_project_id uuid
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select
    p.project_code,
    p.name as project_name,
    p.clickup_parent_task_id,
    p.id as calculator_project_id
  from public.projects p
  where p.git_remote_url is not null
    and public.normalise_git_remote(p.git_remote_url) = public.normalise_git_remote(remote)
    and p.status = 'in_progress'
  order by p.created_at desc
  limit 1;
$$;

-- Grant execute to anon — the hook calls this with the publishable key
-- so it works in any developer's terminal without per-user auth setup.
-- The function is read-only and exposes only the four fields above
-- (no PII beyond project name + ClickUp task ID, both already visible
-- to anyone with calculator access).
grant execute on function public.resolve_project_for_repo(text) to anon;
grant execute on function public.normalise_git_remote(text) to anon;
```

## Phase 6 — `~/.claude/hooks/sessionstart-cc-project.sh`

### Task 6.1: Create the SessionStart hook

**Files:**
- Create: `~/.claude/hooks/sessionstart-cc-project.sh`

- [ ] **Step 1: Create the hooks directory**

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/hooks && chmod 755 ~/.claude/hooks
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Write the hook**

```bash
cat > ~/.claude/hooks/sessionstart-cc-project.sh <<'BASH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# sessionstart-cc-project.sh
#
# Resolves the active CC project at session start so the Stop hook can
# attribute token usage. Resolution order:
#   1. .cc-project file (walking up from cwd) — explicit, fastest
#   2. git remote get-url origin → Supabase RPC resolve_project_for_repo
#   3. Nothing → Stop hook will route to Unallocated AI bucket
#
# Output goes to stdout, which Claude Code injects into context per
# https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks-guide. Also writes the resolved
# binding to ~/.claude/hooks/.session-state/<sessionid>.json for the
# Stop hook to read without re-resolving.
#
# Required env vars (export these in ~/.zshenv):
#   CC_CALC_URL          — base Supabase URL, e.g. https://lpgwxacoqiqpcfpkklib.supabase.co
#   CC_CALC_ANON_KEY     — Supabase publishable key (anon)

set -euo pipefail

# Read the SessionStart hook payload from stdin (JSON: { session_id, ... }).
# We only use session_id for the state file name.
PAYLOAD="$(cat)"
SESSION_ID="$(printf '%s' "$PAYLOAD" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("session_id",""))')"

STATE_DIR="${HOME}/.claude/hooks/.session-state"
mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
STATE_FILE="${STATE_DIR}/${SESSION_ID}.json"

# 1. Walk up from cwd looking for .cc-project
DIR="$PWD"
CC_PROJECT=""
while [ "$DIR" != "/" ]; do
  if [ -f "$DIR/.cc-project" ]; then
    CC_PROJECT="$DIR/.cc-project"
    break
  fi
  DIR="$(dirname "$DIR")"
done

if [ -n "$CC_PROJECT" ]; then
  cp "$CC_PROJECT" "$STATE_FILE"
  CODE="$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('$STATE_FILE'))['project_code'])")"
  NAME="$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('$STATE_FILE'))['project_name'])")"
  echo "[cc-project] Active project: ${CODE} — ${NAME} (from .cc-project)"
  exit 0
fi

# 2. Try git remote
REMOTE="$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -z "$REMOTE" ]; then
  echo "[cc-project] No .cc-project file and no git remote — AI usage will route to Unallocated bucket"
  echo '{}' > "$STATE_FILE"
  exit 0
fi

if [ -z "${CC_CALC_URL:-}" ] || [ -z "${CC_CALC_ANON_KEY:-}" ]; then
  echo "[cc-project] CC_CALC_URL or CC_CALC_ANON_KEY env vars not set — skipping RPC resolve"
  echo '{}' > "$STATE_FILE"
  exit 0
fi

# Call Supabase RPC. Fail-open: any HTTP/parse error → unbound.
RESPONSE="$(curl -sS --max-time 5 \
  -X POST "${CC_CALC_URL}/rest/v1/rpc/resolve_project_for_repo" \
  -H "apikey: ${CC_CALC_ANON_KEY}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CC_CALC_ANON_KEY}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"remote\":\"${REMOTE}\"}" 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"

# RPC returns an array; take the first row if any.
RESOLVED="$(printf '%s' "$RESPONSE" | python3 -c '
import sys, json
try:
  rows = json.load(sys.stdin)
  if isinstance(rows, list) and rows:
    r = rows[0]
    print(json.dumps({
      "project_code": r["project_code"],
      "project_name": r["project_name"],
      "clickup_parent_task_id": r["clickup_parent_task_id"],
      "calculator_project_id": r["calculator_project_id"],
    }))
except Exception:
  pass
')"

if [ -n "$RESOLVED" ]; then
  printf '%s' "$RESOLVED" > "$STATE_FILE"
  CODE="$(printf '%s' "$RESOLVED" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["project_code"])')"
  NAME="$(printf '%s' "$RESOLVED" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["project_name"])')"
  echo "[cc-project] Active project: ${CODE} — ${NAME} (resolved via git remote)"
else
  echo "[cc-project] Git remote ${REMOTE} not linked to any project — AI usage will route to Unallocated bucket"
  echo '{}' > "$STATE_FILE"
fi
BASH

chmod +x ~/.claude/hooks/sessionstart-cc-project.sh
```

## Phase 7 — `~/.claude/hooks/stop-ai-cost.py` + settings registration

### Task 7.1: Create the Stop hook script

**Files:**
- Create: `~/.claude/hooks/stop-ai-cost.py`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the script**

```bash
cat > ~/.claude/hooks/stop-ai-cost.py <<'PY'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
stop-ai-cost.py — Claude Code Stop hook

Reads the session JSONL pointed to by `transcript_path` in the Stop event
payload, sums tokens by model, computes ZAR cost via a hardcoded rate
table, computes active duration with idle-gap capping (5min cap), and
PATCHes the four AI custom fields on the resolved ClickUp parent task.

Reads the binding written by sessionstart-cc-project.sh from
~/.claude/hooks/.session-state/<session_id>.json. If empty, posts to
the Unallocated AI bucket task (settings.unallocated_ai_clickup_task_id
on the calculator).

Idempotency: stores the per-session totals in
~/.claude/hooks/.attributed/<session_id>.json. On re-run we ADD the delta
between the new and previous totals (not the absolute) so concurrent or
restarted sessions don't double-count.

Failure mode: fail-open. Errors logged to ~/.claude/hooks/stop-ai-cost.err
but NEVER block session end.

Required env vars:
  CC_CALC_URL          — Supabase URL (for fetching settings + bucket id)
  CC_CALC_ANON_KEY     — Supabase publishable key
  CLICKUP_PAT          — ClickUp personal access token (pk_...)
"""
import json
import os
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

# Per-model ZAR cost per million tokens (refreshed quarterly; mirror the
# wiki's [[research/ai-usage-tracking/04-costing-and-business-model]]).
RATES_ZAR_PER_MTOK = {
    "claude-opus-4-7":          {"input": 83.0,  "output": 416.0},
    "claude-opus-4-7[1m]":      {"input": 83.0,  "output": 416.0},
    "claude-sonnet-4-6":        {"input": 50.0,  "output": 249.0},
    "claude-haiku-4-5":         {"input": 17.0,  "output": 83.0},
    "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001":{"input": 17.0,  "output": 83.0},
}
DEFAULT_RATE = {"input": 50.0, "output": 249.0}  # fallback = sonnet pricing
IDLE_CAP_SECONDS = 300  # 5 min — gaps longer than this don't count

ERR_LOG = Path.home() / ".claude/hooks/stop-ai-cost.err"
STATE_DIR = Path.home() / ".claude/hooks/.session-state"
ATTRIB_DIR = Path.home() / ".claude/hooks/.attributed"
ATTRIB_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def log_err(msg):
    try:
        ERR_LOG.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with ERR_LOG.open("a") as f:
            f.write(f"{datetime.now().isoformat()} {msg}\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def http_post_json(url, headers, body):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers={**headers, "Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
        return r.status, r.read().decode()


def http_get_json(url, headers):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers, method="GET")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read().decode())


def parse_jsonl(path):
    """Walk the session JSONL, summing tokens per model and timestamps."""
    tokens_by_model = {}
    timestamps = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            try:
                ev = json.loads(line)
            except Exception:
                continue
            ts = ev.get("timestamp")
            if ts:
                try:
                    timestamps.append(datetime.fromisoformat(ts.replace("Z", "+00:00")).timestamp())
                except Exception:
                    pass
            usage = (ev.get("message") or {}).get("usage") if isinstance(ev.get("message"), dict) else None
            if not usage:
                continue
            model = (ev.get("message") or {}).get("model") or ev.get("model") or "unknown"
            agg = tokens_by_model.setdefault(model, {"input": 0, "output": 0})
            agg["input"] += int(usage.get("input_tokens", 0)) \
                          + int(usage.get("cache_creation_input_tokens", 0)) \
                          + int(usage.get("cache_read_input_tokens", 0))
            agg["output"] += int(usage.get("output_tokens", 0))
    return tokens_by_model, sorted(timestamps)


def active_minutes(timestamps, idle_cap=IDLE_CAP_SECONDS):
    if len(timestamps) < 2:
        return 0
    total = 0
    for i in range(1, len(timestamps)):
        gap = timestamps[i] - timestamps[i - 1]
        total += min(gap, idle_cap)
    return round(total / 60)


def cost_zar(tokens_by_model):
    total = 0.0
    for model, t in tokens_by_model.items():
        rate = RATES_ZAR_PER_MTOK.get(model, DEFAULT_RATE)
        total += (t["input"] / 1_000_000) * rate["input"]
        total += (t["output"] / 1_000_000) * rate["output"]
    return round(total, 2)


def fetch_unallocated_task_id():
    url = os.environ.get("CC_CALC_URL")
    key = os.environ.get("CC_CALC_ANON_KEY")
    if not url or not key:
        return None
    try:
        resp = http_get_json(
            f"{url}/rest/v1/settings?id=eq.1&select=unallocated_ai_clickup_task_id",
            {"apikey": key, "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"},
        )
        if isinstance(resp, list) and resp:
            return resp[0].get("unallocated_ai_clickup_task_id")
    except Exception as e:
        log_err(f"unallocated fetch: {e}")
    return None


def get_clickup_field_ids(task_id, pat):
    """Fetch the task to discover its custom_fields' ids by name."""
    try:
        task = http_get_json(
            f"https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/task/{task_id}",
            {"Authorization": pat},
        )
        out = {}
        for cf in task.get("custom_fields", []):
            out[cf["name"]] = cf["id"]
        return out
    except Exception as e:
        log_err(f"clickup get task {task_id}: {e}")
        return {}


def post_clickup_field(task_id, field_id, value, pat):
    try:
        status, body = http_post_json(
            f"https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/task/{task_id}/field/{field_id}",
            {"Authorization": pat},
            {"value": value},
        )
        if status >= 300:
            log_err(f"clickup field {field_id} on {task_id}: HTTP {status} {body}")
            return False
        return True
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        log_err(f"clickup field {field_id} on {task_id}: HTTP {e.code} {e.read().decode()[:200]}")
    except Exception as e:
        log_err(f"clickup field {field_id} on {task_id}: {e}")
    return False


def main():
    payload = json.load(sys.stdin)
    transcript_path = payload.get("transcript_path")
    session_id = payload.get("session_id", "")
    if not transcript_path or not Path(transcript_path).exists():
        log_err(f"no transcript: {payload}")
        return

    # Parse session
    tokens_by_model, timestamps = parse_jsonl(transcript_path)
    in_total = sum(t["input"] for t in tokens_by_model.values())
    out_total = sum(t["output"] for t in tokens_by_model.values())
    minutes = active_minutes(timestamps)
    cost = cost_zar(tokens_by_model)

    if in_total == 0 and out_total == 0:
        return  # empty session, nothing to attribute

    # Resolve binding
    state_file = STATE_DIR / f"{session_id}.json"
    binding = {}
    if state_file.exists():
        try:
            binding = json.loads(state_file.read_text())
        except Exception:
            pass

    task_id = binding.get("clickup_parent_task_id")
    if not task_id:
        task_id = fetch_unallocated_task_id()
        if not task_id:
            log_err(f"no binding and no unallocated task — dropping session {session_id}: in={in_total} out={out_total}")
            return

    pat = os.environ.get("CLICKUP_PAT")
    if not pat:
        log_err("CLICKUP_PAT not set")
        return

    # Idempotency: ADD the delta between this run's totals and any previous
    # run for the same session. JSONL tail-grows, so re-runs always have
    # equal-or-greater totals than previous runs.
    attrib_file = ATTRIB_DIR / f"{session_id}.json"
    prev = {"input": 0, "output": 0, "cost": 0.0, "minutes": 0}
    if attrib_file.exists():
        try:
            prev = json.loads(attrib_file.read_text())
        except Exception:
            pass

    delta_in = max(0, in_total - prev["input"])
    delta_out = max(0, out_total - prev["output"])
    delta_cost = round(max(0, cost - prev["cost"]), 2)
    delta_min = max(0, minutes - prev["minutes"])

    if delta_in == 0 and delta_out == 0 and delta_cost == 0 and delta_min == 0:
        return  # nothing new since last run

    # Discover field IDs from the target task
    field_ids = get_clickup_field_ids(task_id, pat)

    # Read current values to add delta to (we only have field IDs, need
    # the values from the same GET). Re-fetch as the post above is async-ish.
    try:
        task = http_get_json(f"https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/task/{task_id}", {"Authorization": pat})
    except Exception as e:
        log_err(f"clickup task fetch for current values: {e}")
        return

    current = {}
    for cf in task.get("custom_fields", []):
        v = cf.get("value")
        if v is None:
            current[cf["name"]] = 0
        else:
            try:
                current[cf["name"]] = float(v)
            except Exception:
                current[cf["name"]] = 0

    updates = {
        "AI Input Tokens":     int(current.get("AI Input Tokens", 0))   + delta_in,
        "AI Output Tokens":    int(current.get("AI Output Tokens", 0))  + delta_out,
        "AI Cost ZAR":         round(current.get("AI Cost ZAR", 0)      + delta_cost, 2),
        "AI Duration Minutes": int(current.get("AI Duration Minutes", 0)) + delta_min,
    }

    for fname, value in updates.items():
        fid = field_ids.get(fname)
        if not fid:
            log_err(f"field {fname} missing on task {task_id}")
            continue
        post_clickup_field(task_id, fid, value, pat)

    # Persist totals for next-run delta calc
    attrib_file.write_text(json.dumps({
        "input": in_total,
        "output": out_total,
        "cost": cost,
        "minutes": minutes,
        "task_id": task_id,
        "updated_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
    }))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except Exception as e:
        log_err(f"fatal: {e}")
PY

chmod +x ~/.claude/hooks/stop-ai-cost.py
```

## Phase 8 — Commit `.cc-project` to this repo (the calculator's own dogfood)

This is the recursive case: the calculator's own repo gets a `.cc-project` file pointing at its own ClickUp parent task (once one exists for it).

- [ ] **Step 1: From the calculator's project page in the UI, click "Copy .cc-project"**

(After Phase 4. Requires a project to exist in the calculator that maps to a ClickUp parent task tracking the calculator's own work.)

- [ ] **Step 2: Paste into `.cc-project` at repo root**

```bash
# Paste from clipboard:
pbpaste > /Users/brendangunn/Github/cc-service-calculator/.cc-project
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Verify it's readable by the SessionStart hook**

```bash
cd /Users/brendangunn/Github/cc-service-calculator
echo '{"session_id":"dogfood-test"}' | ~/.claude/hooks/sessionstart-cc-project.sh
cat ~/.claude/hooks/.session-state/dogfood-test.json
```

Expected: state file has the project metadata sourced from `.cc-project`.

- [ ] **Step 4: Decide commit policy**

The architecture decision was **commit** `.cc-project` (not gitignore) — it's a property of the codebase. But verify nothing sensitive leaked: open the file, confirm it only contains `project_code`, `project_name`, `clickup_parent_task_id`, `calculator_project_id` (the four fields written by the Copy button).

```bash
git add .cc-project
git commit -m "chore: add .cc-project for AI usage attribution

Maps this repo to its calculator project so the SessionStart hook
can resolve the binding without a network call. See
~/.claude/hooks/sessionstart-cc-project.sh."
```

## Self-review checklist (run before considering this plan done)

1. **Spec coverage:**
   - ✅ Project reference code (`CC-<YY><seq4>`) — Phase 1
   - ✅ Reference pushed to ClickUp on quote sign-off — Phase 2
   - ✅ Reference round-trips into Claude Code — Phases 5+6+7
   - ✅ Token usage flows into ClickUp tasks — Phase 7
   - ✅ Idempotent (re-runnable Stop hook doesn't double-count) — Phase 7 attrib_file logic
   - ✅ Fail-open (errors never block sessions) — Phase 7
   - ✅ POPIA-minimal (no prompt content, no file paths leak to ClickUp) — Phase 7 only posts numerics
   - ✅ Bumps `cleanupPeriodDays = 365` — Phase 7.2 step 2
   - ✅ Unallocated bucket for unbound sessions — Phase 3.2

2. **Type consistency:**
   - `project_code text not null` (Phase 1) → typed as `string` in `db.ts` (Phase 1.2)
   - `git_remote_url text` (Phase 1) → `string | null`
   - `findCustomField(cuFields, name, type?)` (Phase 2.1) — signature matches usage in Phase 2.2
   - RPC return shape (Phase 5) matches `.cc-project` JSON shape (Phase 4.2): `project_code`, `project_name`, `clickup_parent_task_id`, `calculator_project_id`

3. **No placeholders:** every step has either exact code, exact MCP call, or exact CLI command.

## Known follow-ups (deliberately out of scope)

- **Outbox + retry pattern for ClickUp provisioning** — current `push-to-clickup` is synchronous. If ClickUp rate limits or goes down at sign-off, the user retries manually. Promote to outbox if this happens >1×/month.
- **Multi-task-within-session attribution** — current Stop hook attributes the whole session to the resolved parent. The wiki's `<task-marker>` proposal (D3 from cc-vault) gives sub-task granularity but is sub-skill-level work. `/task <id>` slash command remains the manual override path.
- **`/ai-invoice` skill** — monthly rollup. Build after 1 week of clean data so reconciliation against `ccusage` works.
- **Retroactive backfill (`cc-attribute --since 2026-04-01`)** — separate skill. Only valuable if April 2026 data is needed for invoicing.
